_note: APPROXIMATE, HAND-WRITTEN DATA. A listing on chain has no coordinates, so this file places the demo's listings on the map for the "near an event" filter. Each entry is a district-level centroid of a real Kraków or Warsaw neighbourhood, rounded to ~100 m -- not a street address, and not where anybody lives. Matched to a listing by title+city (the on-chain listing_id is a per-landlord fallback). A listing that is absent from this file is treated as location-unknown: it is listed as usual, without a distance. Served from app/public, so editing it needs no rebuild. See docs/events.md.
